question: For window and rank-d label-GAP symmetric bases on prime-order E/F_p, is the growth exponent delta of the pair-sum coincidence excess kappa in N below the h = 2 break-even rate 1/3 over 16-32 bits?

claims.text: Every valid structured line (theta 0.30/0.35 x d 1-3) has upper95(delta) < 1/3 with all blocking controls passing and at least 5 of 6 lines valid (reading O-SUB-BE).
claims.if_supported: Record the six lines sub-break-even at h = 2 over 16-32 bits after independent review; toy scope only.
claims.if_not_supported: O-ALIVE: price the surviving line against matched rho in a successor contract; O-MIXED/O-INVALID: no reading, named repair.

claims.text: The instrument recovers planted slopes (gamma 0, 1/6, 1/3, 1/2) within 0.03 and the Z/N interval slope 1 - theta within 0.05, and its null is calibrated (A/A, z_cal). C-aa-null and the z_cal band set the noise floor and are blocking gates (C5, C6), not deciding comparisons.
No cost, speedup, attack or claim beyond 32 bits is made.

arms.description: Six preregistered window (d = 1) and label-GAP (d = 2, 3) symmetric bases of b = 2*round(2^(bits*theta)/2) points, per (rung, theta, d, curve).

factors.how: disjoint fresh blocks; v1 blocks never reused

comparisons.threshold: upper95(delta) < 1/3 on every valid line (SUB-BE/SUB-BE-GROWING); ALIVE iff lower95 > 0 and upper95 >= 1/3, replicated on the 12,200,000 block
interval contains 0 on >= 5 of 6 lines, none ALIVE; z_cal sd in [0.70, 1.30], |mean| <= 0.40
|delta_hat - gamma_design| <= 0.03; classes gamma 0 SUB-BE, 1/6 SUB-BE-GROWING, 1/2 ALIVE

randomization.arm_order_reason: Exact counts per job; no timing metric, so order cannot bias a primary metric.

seed_derivation.note: curve seed = block + c (c < 4000); base seeds sha256('EXP-PFDR-ada71b|' + labels).

instance_sampling.rule: Curves 0..n_curves-1 of each fresh block, n_curves from design.json; never selected by outcome.

blinding.how: Frozen deterministic analysis (run.py analyze) with preregistered thresholds; no analyst choice after data.

power.note: Per cell M >= 2500 null coincidences (Poisson sd of log kappa about 0.02 per rung); v1 plant recovery at these sizes was within 0.012 of design on the valid theta, so a delta of 1/3 versus 0 is resolved by a wide margin. Classes are per line, not a family test; the reading requires every line.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: v1 wall times (census-main 293 s, pilot 32 s) scaled by the v2 curve counts; protective watchdogs only.

primary.name: per-line slope
primary.definition: OLS slope of log2 kappa_r on rung mean log2 N over five rungs
primary.formula: delta_hat = sum((x_r - xbar)(y_r - ybar)) / sum((x_r - xbar)^2), x_r = mean log2 N over rung r curves, y_r = log2(S_r / M_r)

primary.name: reading
primary.definition: first matching outcome rule (O-INVALID, O-ALIVE, O-PENDING-REPLICATION, O-SUB-BE, O-MIXED)

secondary.name: coincidence counts
secondary.definition: S (structured) and M (null mean) per cell under the CC convention

secondary.name: calibration z
secondary.formula: z_cal = (sum_c n_c[k] - sum_c mean(n_c[-k])) / sqrt(sum_c var(n_c[-k]) (1 + 1/19)), k = d - 1

stopping_rules.rule: Six planned trials in order (selftest, pilot, census-main, analyze-main, census-rep, analyze-final); census-rep only for ALIVE lines.
A kernel call over 3600 s is failed_infrastructure; its cell is invalid, never null.

invalidation_rules: manifest code or trial-plan hash differs from the frozen plan
trial-plan defaults differ from driver constants

decision_rule.text: analysis.json /reading under the frozen outcome rules of the specification; O-SUB-BE supports, O-ALIVE (replicated) falsifies, O-MIXED and O-INVALID decide nothing. The six-line family is an intersection-union test (support needs every valid line below 1/3), which needs no per-line alpha adjustment; C-aa-null (C5) and z_cal (C6) are blocking gates.
decision_rule.statistic: per-line OLS slope with curve-cluster bootstrap interval

inadmissible: No statement beyond bits 16-32, h = 2 and these lines.
No cost, speedup or attack claim; delta is a growth exponent only.
v1 (EXP-PFDR-2d36f9) records are never pooled with v2.
No line is selected after data.

literature.claim: v1 O-INVALID reading and its instrument causes (R6).
